description: This file contains shell script functions related to platform-specific checks, upgrades, and configurations for OpenWrt on i.MX Cortex-A9 devices. It includes functions for enabling image metadata checks, verifying platform compatibility, performing firmware upgrades, copying configurations, and pre-upgrade steps, with references to device-specific scripts and commands.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata verification for specific boards based on their name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the current device supports image flashing or upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade operation tailored to specific device models.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies necessary configuration files for specific boards prior to upgrade.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade steps for certain boards, like preparing SD card images.
